pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with jagged, serrated edges. Dark pigments vary in intensity, showing some internal textural grain. Edge gradients are characterized by soft, feathered transitions into the lighter corridors rather than sharp geometric breaks. Patch size is largest on the central flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A high-frequency topological web of light-colored negative space. Intersections are primarily tri-junction nodes. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, exhibiting thinning in mid-pathway and broadening at nodal points. Continuity is high across the mid-lateral plane, forming a complete circuit around most dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a dense, vertical textural silhouette. The amplitude of the serrations is short and consistent, creating a fuzzy, high-frequency 1D contour against the sky-colored background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural dip and thinning of the mane line is present at the posterior base of the neck before it meets the shoulder ridge.
